changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE pendingPushes ( id serial NOT NULL CONSTRAINT pending_push_pr_key PRIMARY KEY, messageId INT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES pushMessages( id ) ON DELETE CASCADE, status INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, createTime BIGINT NOT NULL, sendTime BIGINT );

changeSet.author: hmdm-evolution
changeSet.comment: F1.1: Extend pendingPushes for command lifecycle tracking (ACK protocol prep)
changeSet.rollback: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_pending_state_device; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_pending_next_attempt; DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_pending_expires; ALTER TABLE pendingPushes DROP COLUMN device_sequence_num, DROP COLUMN delivered_ack_at, DROP COLUMN executed_ack_at, DROP COLUMN failed_at, DROP COLUMN failure_code, DROP COLUMN failure_message, DROP COLUMN retry_count, DROP COLUMN max_retries, DROP COLUMN next_attempt_at, DROP COLUMN expires_at, DROP COLUMN correlation_id, DROP COLUMN created_by_user_id, DROP COLUMN created_by_source;

changeSet.author: hmdm-evolution
changeSet.comment: F1.2: Trigger to populate device_sequence_num and expires_at on insert
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_pending_pushes_sequence ON pendingPushes; DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS fn_pending_pushes_set_sequence();

changeSet.author: hmdm-evolution
changeSet.comment: F1.3: Append-only audit log for command state transitions

changeSet.author: hmdm-evolution
changeSet.comment: F1.5: Derived state view (no schema impact, helper for queries and admin UI)
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_command_state AS SELECT p.messageId, p.id AS pending_id, m.deviceId, m.messageType, m.payload, p.createTime AS created_at, p.sendTime AS sent_at, p.delivered_ack_at, p.executed_ack_at, p.failed_at, p.expires_at, p.retry_count, p.max_retries, p.failure_code, p.failure_message, p.device_sequence_num, p.correlation_id, p.created_by_user_id, p.created_by_source, CASE WHEN p.executed_ack_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'EXECUTED' WHEN p.failed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'FAILED' WHEN p.delivered_ack_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'DELIVERED' WHEN p.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND p.expires_at < EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) * 1000 THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN p.status = 1 THEN 'IN_FLIGHT' ELSE 'ENQUEUED' END AS state FROM pendingPushes p INNER JOIN pushMessages m ON m.id = p.messageId;
